method: Read-only Python struct PE import table parsing and ASCII-subset UTF-16LE run enumeration of exact REA resource payload ranges. Text runs are not a semantic dialog/menu decoder; presence does not establish runtime behavior. Manifest decoded as UTF-8. No target loading/execution.
